question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is** "Overwelming."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling is** 'Overwhelming'** with an **'h.'** • The mistake in Option 3 is the incorrect spelling of the word. • **"Overwhelming" **means extremely great or strong. (अत्‍यधिक महान या शक्तिशाली, तीव्र) • **Example**: *She felt an **overwhelming**__ desire to tell someone about what had happened.* • The correct answer is Option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **'Persistent' (Option 1)** means continuing to exist or endure over a prolonged period of time. ((लोगों द्वारा मना या निरुत्‍साहित किए जाने के बावजूद) किसी काम को करते रहने के लिए कृत संकल्‍प) • **'Repetition' (Option 2)** means the action of repeating something that has already been said or written. (पुनरावृति; दोहराई हुई वस्‍तु) • **'Audacious' (Option 4) **means showing a willingness to take surprisingly bold risks. (ख़तरा उठाने या स्‍तब्‍धकारी कार्य करने को तैयार; निर्भीक, निडर) 3c:Tbbb, The correct answer is **"Agony."**
